pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmatā Dabbena Mallaputtena jātiyā sattavassena arahattaṃ sacchikataṃ hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.3: yaṃ kiñci sāvakena pattabbaṃ sabbaṃ tena anuppattaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.4: n' atthi c' assa kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ katassa vā paticayo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.5: atha kho āyasmato Dabbassa Mallaputtassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evañ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.6: mayā kho jātiyā sattavassena arahattaṃ sacchikataṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.7: yaṃ kiñci sāvakena pattabbaṃ sabbaṃ mayā anuppattaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.8: n' atthi ca me kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ katassa vā paticayo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.9: kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ saṃghassa veyyāvaccaṃ kareyyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.10: atha kho āyasmato Dabbassa Mallaputtassa etad ahosi: yaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.11: nūnāhaṃ saṃghassa senāsanañ ca paññāpeyyaṃ bhattāni ca uddiseyyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.1: atha kho āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.3: idha mayhaṃ bhante rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa . . . veyyāvaccaṃ kareyyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhante etad ahosi: yaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.5: nūnāhaṃ saṃghassa senāsanañ ca paññāpeyyaṃ bhattāni ca uddiseyyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.6: icchām' ahaṃ bhante saṃghassa senāsanañ ca paññāpetuṃ bhattāni ca uddisitun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.8: tena hi tvaṃ Dabba saṃghassa senāsanañ ca paññāpehi bhattāni ca uddisā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.9: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto bhagavato paccassosi. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.3.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.3.2: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ senāsanapaññāpakañ ca bhattuddesakañ ca sammannatu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.3.5: yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.3.7: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ senāsanapaññāpakañ ca bhattuddesakañ ca sammanneyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.3.10: saṃgho āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ senāsanapaññāpakañ ca bhattuddesakañ ca sammannati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.3.11: yassāyasmato khamati āyasmato Dabbassa Mallaputtassa senāsanapaññāpakassa ca bhattuddesakassa ca sammuti so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.3.13: sammato saṃghena āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto senāsanapaññāpako ca bhattuddesako ca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.1: sammato ca panāyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto sabhāgānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsannaṃ paññāpeti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.2: ye te bhikkhū suttantikā tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.4: ye te bhikkhū vinayadharā tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.6: ye te bhikkhū dhammakathikā tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.8: ye te bhikkhū jhāyino tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.10: ye te bhikkhū tiracchānakathikā kāyadaḷhībahulā viharanti tesam pi ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.11: imāya p' ime āyasmantā ratiyā acchissantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.12: ye pi te bhikkhū vikāle āgacchanti tesam pi tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā ten' eva ālokena senāsanaṃ paññāpeti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.13: api ssu bhikkhū sañcicca vikāle āgacchanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.14: mayaṃ āyasmato Dabbassa Mallaputtassa iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ passissāmā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.15: te āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.17: te āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.20: amhākaṃ āvuso Dabba Gijjhakūṭe senāsanaṃ paññāpehi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.22: amhākaṃ āvuso Isigilipasse Kāḷasilāyaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpehi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.23: amhākaṃ āvuso Vebhārapasse Sattapaṇṇiguhāyaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpehi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.24: amhākaṃ āvuso Sītavane Sappasoṇḍikapabbhāre senāsanaṃ paññāpehi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.30: amhākaṃ āvuso Maddakucchismiṃ migadāye senāsanaṃ paññāpehīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.31: tesaṃ āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā aṅguliyā jalamānāya purato purato gacchati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.32: te pi ten' eva ālokena āyasmato Dabbassa Mallaputtassa piṭṭhito piṭṭhito gacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.33: tesaṃ āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto evaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.34: ayaṃ mañco idaṃ pīṭhaṃ ayaṃ bhisī idaṃ bimbohanaṃ idaṃ vaccaṭṭhānaṃ idaṃ passāvaṭṭhānaṃ idaṃ pāniyaṃ idaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ ayaṃ kattaradaṇḍo
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.35: idaṃ saṃghassa katikasaṇṭhānaṃ imaṃ kālaṃ pavisitabbaṃ imaṃ kālaṃ nikkhamitabban ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.36: tesaṃ āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto evaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpetvā punad eva Veḷuvanaṃ paccāgacchati. ||4||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.1: tena kho pana samayena Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū navakā c' eva honti appapuññā ca,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.2: yāni saṃghassa lāmakāni senāsanāni tāni tesaṃ pāpuṇanti lāmakāni ca bhattāni.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.3: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe manussā icchanti therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhisaṃkhārikaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ dātuṃ sappiṃ pi telaṃ pi uttaribhaṅgaṃ pi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.4: Mettiyabhummajakānaṃ pana bhikkhūnaṃ pākatikaṃ denti yathāraddhaṃ kaṇājakaṃ bilaṅgadutiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.5: te pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā there bhikkhū pucchanti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.6: tumhākaṃ āvuso bhattagge kiṃ ahosi, tumhākaṃ kiṃ ahosīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.8: amhākaṃ āvuso sappi ahosi telaṃ ahosi uttaribhaṅgaṃ ahosīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.10: amhākaṃ āvuso na kiñci ahosi pākatikaṃ yathāraddhaṃ kaṇājakaṃ bilaṅgadutiyan ti. ||5||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.1: tena kho pana samayena kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati saṃghassa catukkabhattaṃ deti niccabhattaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.3: aññe odanena pucchanti aññe sūpena pucchanti aññe telena pucchanti aññe uttaribhaṅgena pucchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.4: tena kho pana samayena kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino bhattaṃ svātanāya Mettiyabhummajakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ uddiṭṭhaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.5: atha kho kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati ārāmaṃ agamāsi kenacid eva karaṇīyena,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.6: so yenāyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.7: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho kalyāṇabhattikaṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi . . . sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.8: atha kho kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati āyasmatā Dabbena Mallaputtena dhammiyā kathāya sandassito . . . sampahaṃsito āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.9: kassa bhante amhākaṃ ghare svātanāya bhattaṃ uddiṭṭhan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.10: Mettiyabhummajakānaṃ kho gahapati bhikkhūnaṃ tumhākaṃ ghare svātanāya bhattaṃ uddiṭṭhan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.11: atha kho kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati anattamano ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.12: kathaṃ hi nāma pāpabhikkhū amhākaṃ ghare bhuñjissantīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.14: ye je sve bhattikā āgacchanti te koṭṭhake āsanaṃ paññāpetvā kaṇājakena bilaṅgadutiyena parivisā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.15: evaṃ ayyā 'ti kho sā dāsī kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino paccassosi. ||6||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.2: hiyyo kho āvuso amhākaṃ kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino bhattaṃ uddiṭṭhaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.3: sve amhe kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati saputtadāro upatiṭṭhitvā parivisissati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.4: aññe odanena pucchissanti aññe sūpena pucchissanti aññe telena pucchissanti aññe uttaribhaṅgena pucchissantīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.5: te ten' eva somanassena na cittarūpaṃ rattiyā supiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.6: atha kho Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.7: addasa kho sā dāsī Mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū dūrato 'va āgacchante, disvāna koṭṭhake āsanaṃ paññāpetvā Mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.9: atha kho Mettiyabhummajakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.10: nissaṃsayaṃ kho na tāva bhattaṃ siddhaṃ bhavissati yathā mayaṃ koṭṭhake nisīdāpeyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.11: atha kho sā dāsī kaṇājakena bilaṅgadutiyena upagacchi
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.15: api cāhaṃ hiyyo 'va gahapatinā āṇattā: ye je sve bhattikā āgacchanti te koṭṭhake āsanaṃ paññāpetvā kaṇājakena bilaṅgadutiyena parivisā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.18: hiyyo kho āvuso kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati ārāmaṃ agamāsi Dabbassa Mallaputtassa santike,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.19: nissaṃsayaṃ kho mayaṃ Dabbena Mallaputtena gahapatino santike paribhinnā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.20: te ten' eva domanassena na cittarūpaṃ bhuñjiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.21: atha kho Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā ārāmaṃ gantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭisāmetvā bahārāmakoṭṭhake saṃghāṭipallatthikāya nisīdiṃsu tuṇhibhūtā maṅkubhūtā pattakkhandhā adhomukhā pajjhāyantā appaṭibhānā. ||7||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.1: atha kho Mettiyā bhikkhunī yena Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.5: tatiyam pi kho Mettiyā bhikkhunī Mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.7: tatiyam pi kho Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū nālapiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.10: tathā hi pana tvaṃ bhagini amhe Dabbena Mallaputtena viheṭhiyamāne ajjhupekkhasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.12: sace kho tvaṃ bhagini iccheyyāsi ajj' eva bhagavā Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ nāsāpeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.13: ky āhaṃ ayyā karomi, kiṃ mayā sakkā kātun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.14: ehi tvaṃ bhagini yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkama, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.15: idaṃ bhante na cchannaṃ na paṭirūpaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.16: yāyaṃ bhante disā abhayā anītikā anupaddavā sāyaṃ disā sabhayā saītikā saupaddavā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.20: evaṃ ayyā 'ti kho Mettiyā bhikkhunī Mettiyabhummajakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.21: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho Mettiyā bhikkhunī bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.2: sarasi tvaṃ Dabba evarūpaṃ kattā yathāyaṃ bhikkhunī āhā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.5: tatiyam pi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ etad avoca . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.8: na kho Dabba Dabbā evaṃ nibbeṭhenti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.9: sace tayā kataṃ katan ti vadehi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.11: yato ahaṃ bhante jāto nābhijānāmi supinantena pi methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitā pag eva jāgaro 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.13: tena hi bhikkhave Mettiyaṃ bhikkhuniṃ nāsetha
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.15: idaṃ vatvā bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.16: atha kho te bhikkhū Mettiyaṃ bhikkhuniṃ nāsesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.17: atha kho Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū te bhikkhū etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.20: amhehi sā ussāhitā kupitehi anattamanehi cāvanādhippāyehīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.21: kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃsethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.23: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.24: kathaṃ hi nāma Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃsessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.25: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.26: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃsethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.29: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃsessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.30: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.31: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.32.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya app eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.33: tato aparena samayena samanuggāhiyamāno vā asamanuggāhiyamāno vā amūlakañ c' eva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṃghādiseso 'ti. ||9||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:2.10: tena ca kopena tena ca dosena tāya ca anattamanatāya tāya ca anabhiraddhiyā appatīto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:2.17: appeva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:2.18: bhikkhubhāvā cāveyyaṃ samaṇadhammā cāveyyaṃ sīlakkhandhā cāveyyaṃ tapoguṇā cāveyyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:2.20: yasmiṃ khaṇe anuddhaṃsito hoti taṃ khaṇaṃ taṃ layaṃ taṃ muhuttaṃ vītivatte.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:2.22: yena vatthunā anuddhaṃsito hoti tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ samanuggāhiyamāno.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:2.26: cattāri adhikaraṇāni vivādādhikaraṇaṃ anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ āpattādhikaraṇaṃ kiccādhikaraṇaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:2.28: tucchakaṃ mayā bhaṇitaṃ musā mayā bhaṇitaṃ abhūtaṃ mayā bhaṇitaṃ ajānantena mayā bhaṇitaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:3.1.1: adiṭṭh' assa hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:3.1.2: tañ ce codeti: diṭṭho mayā pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpanno 'si, asamaṇo
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:3.1.4: n' atthi tayā saddhiṃ uposatho vā pavāraṇā vā saṃghakammaṃ vā 'ti,
